# FlowResult { #timetoalign.timelines.FlowResult }

```python
timelines.FlowResult(runs, findings=())
```

A flow: what is played, in order.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name     | Type                                                                                    | Description                                                                                                                                                                        |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| runs     | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[Interval](`timetoalign.core.Interval`), ...\]                        | The stretches of the axis in the order played, each a half-open :class:`~timetoalign.core.Interval`; stretches played one after the other without a jump between them are one run. |
| findings | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[FlowFinding](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.engine.FlowFinding`), ...\] | What was found on the way, in the order found, the stretches never played last, in the order of the axis. The ``printed`` flow has none.                                           |
